target: [pic=7]Nah, ini dia! Sang penyair yang sedang naik daun!

source: [pic=4]Give us a verse! Drop some lines!
[pic=4]Hehe, yeah, I’m pretty curious to hear what you came up with!
target: [pic=4]Hehe, iya, aku penasaran sekali ingin mendengar hasil karyamu!

source: [pic=4]PFFT! Wow ok! I had a feeling it would be something like that!
target: [pic=4]PFFT! Wah, oke! Sudah kuduga bakal seperti itu!

source: [pic=3]Yet it works pretty well! Certainly invokes some vivid imagery!
target: [pic=3]Tapi hasilnya cukup bagus! Gambaran yang muncul jelas sekali!

source: [pic=4]Heh, it actually reminds me of a poem I wrote… It has similar themes…
target: [pic=4]Heh, itu malah mengingatkanku pada puisi yang kutulis… Temanya mirip…

source:
[pic=4]Gushing from your rear
Fluids running down your legs
Watering the Earth
target:
[pic=4]Pantatmu muncrat
Lelehan di kakimu
Menyiram bumi

source: [pic=3]Ok, something tells me I know exactly what inspired this one!
target: [pic=3]Oke, rasanya aku tahu persis apa yang mengilhaminya!

source: [pic=4]Heh… we should probably fill you in Rascal.
target: [pic=4]Heh… Rascal, sepertinya kami perlu menceritakan latarnya padamu.

source: [pic=4]Well it was one of our earlier interactions together.
target: [pic=4]Jadi, ini terjadi saat kami baru beberapa kali bersama.

source: [pic=4]By this time, we were already pretty friendly, and fooling around here and there.
target: [pic=4]Saat itu kami sudah cukup akrab, dan sesekali main-main mesra.

source: [pic=5]Claire reaaallly wanted to try to get my tip in…
[pic=3]I was wiggling around in all kinds of positions. Violet was coaxing and massaging me the whole time!
target: [pic=3]Aku meliuk-liuk mencoba segala macam posisi. Violet terus membujuk dan memijatku!

source: [pic=3]But she got it in! It was quite impressive, really.
target: [pic=3]Tapi akhirnya dia berhasil memasukkannya! Cukup mengesankan, sungguh.

source: [pic=4]Heh, after all that teasing… I was really on edge!
target: [pic=4]Heh, setelah digoda selama itu… aku sudah di ambang keluar!

source: [pic=3]Right? We got a real silver tongue here.
target: [pic=3]Iya, kan? Ada yang benar-benar berlidah manis di sini.

source: [pic=7]Oh, I’m sure you’re really thinking about his tongue right now!
target: [pic=7]Oh, pasti sekarang kamu benar-benar memikirkan lidahnya!

source: [pic=3]Heh… Seems that tongue can do many great things…
target: [pic=3]Heh… Rupanya lidah itu bisa melakukan banyak hal hebat…

source: [pic=3]Anyways, that was a good poem Oliver.
Who knew Haiku could be sexy!
[pic=7]Yeah I think we need to focus on more sexy haiku.
target: [pic=7]Iya, kurasa kita harus lebih fokus pada haiku seksi.

source: [pic=4]Yeah, since the first one was more about Claire, I wanted one for Violet too..
target: [pic=4]Iya, karena yang pertama lebih tentang Claire, aku juga ingin membuat satu untuk Violet..

source:
[pic=4]Her tender lapping
Cleaning up the mess I made
I’m hard once again
[pic=3]Of course, I can just about hilt Olly these days!
target: [pic=3]Tentu saja, sekarang aku hampir bisa memasukkan Olly sampai pangkalnya!

source: [pic=4]Um heh… I actually had a sequel to that last haiku…
target: [pic=4]Em, heh… Sebenarnya aku punya lanjutan haiku tadi…

source: [pic=3]OK Rascal, you’re up! What do you got for us?
target: [pic=3]Oke, Rascal, giliranmu! Apa yang kamu siapkan untuk kami?

source: [pic=3]I would change it to. "How lucky are we"
[pic=3]It’s very good Oliver, the feeling is quite mutual!
target: [pic=3]Bagus sekali, Oliver. Kami juga merasakan hal yang sama!

source:
[pic=4]Good Drink and Good Friends
On a lazy afternoon
How lucky am I
target:
[pic=4]Minum dan kawan
Pada sore yang santai
Mujurnya aku

source: [pic=3]Oliver, would you like to go next? I can tell you came up with something.
target: [pic=3]Oliver, mau giliran berikutnya? Aku tahu kamu sudah punya sesuatu.

source:
[pic=2]Good Drink and Good Friends
On a lazy afternoon
How lucky am I
target:
[pic=2]Minum dan kawan
Pada sore yang santai
Mujurnya aku

source: [pic=7]I’m not gonna lie - that haiku was a lot lamer until you explained it.
target: [pic=7]Jujur, haikunya jauh lebih garing sebelum kamu jelaskan.

source: [pic=3]Yeah, it may be a bit of a stretch, but that’s what I was thinking when writing.
target: [pic=3]Iya, mungkin agak mengada-ada, tapi itulah yang kupikirkan saat menulisnya.

source: [pic=4]We’re learning from the best after all!
[pic=3]Right? This idea really echos with the idea of time as a whole.
target: [pic=3]Iya, kan? Gagasan ini benar-benar bergema dalam konsep waktu secara keseluruhan.

source: [pic=1]Though we see time as a day to day thing, thousands of years ago, or thousands of years from now - so many things change, yet so much remains the same.
target: [pic=1]Meski kita memandang waktu dari hari ke hari, ribuan tahun lalu, ataupun ribuan tahun mendatang—begitu banyak yang berubah, tetapi begitu banyak pula yang tetap sama.

source: [pic=4]A journey without an end - yet time marches on, and flows like a river.
target: [pic=4]Perjalanan tanpa akhir—namun waktu terus berjalan, mengalir seperti sungai.

source: [pic=5]It’s interesting to consider though, if "time" is the "river," then we are the "water."
target: [pic=5]Tapi menarik juga untuk direnungkan: kalau "waktu" itu "sungai", maka kitalah "airnya".

source: [pic=4]And does the "water" come back in the form of "rain" and "snow"?
target: [pic=4]Lalu apakah "air" itu kembali dalam wujud "hujan" dan "salju"?

source: [pic=4]It’s not my greatest one. But I’ve captured a few concepts in this.
target: [pic=4]Ini bukan karyaku yang terbaik. Tapi ada beberapa konsep yang kutangkap di dalamnya.

source: [pic=1]See Rascal, a difficult part of traditional haiku is the split of two ideas.
target: [pic=1]Begini, Rascal, salah satu kesulitan haiku tradisional adalah pemisahan dua gagasan.

source: [pic=1]Two ideas that contrast each other, they vibrate against each other and change the context of each other.
target: [pic=1]Dua gagasan yang saling berlawanan, saling bergetar dan mengubah konteks satu sama lain.

source: [pic=4]The poem is meant to capture both, the phenomena of an instant of observing water, yet the realization that every droplet of water is new.
target: [pic=4]Puisi itu ingin menangkap keduanya: pengalaman sesaat mengamati air, sekaligus kesadaran bahwa setiap tetes airnya baru.

source: [pic=2]Each droplet that passes this place came from a glacier up above, and who knows, maybe it has made its way back here before.
target: [pic=2]Setiap tetes yang melewati tempat ini berasal dari gletser di atas sana, dan siapa tahu, mungkin pernah kembali ke sini sebelumnya.

source: [pic=1]Oh damn, that’s crazy. I’ve never considered the water flowing down this river is unique…
target: [pic=1]Wah, anjir, luar biasa. Tak pernah kupikirkan bahwa air yang mengalir di sungai ini selalu berbeda…

source:
[pic=4]Marching Forever
A journey without an end
The flowing River
target:
[pic=4]Terus melangkah
Perjalanan tak usai
Sungai mengalir

source: [pic=4]Most haiku reflect nature, a season, and one of the senses.
target: [pic=4]Kebanyakan haiku mencerminkan alam, suatu musim, dan salah satu pancaindra.

source: [pic=1]But before I start. Rascal, do you remember last time when we were chilling?
target: [pic=1]Tapi sebelum mulai, Rascal, kamu ingat waktu kita bersantai bersama dulu?

source: [pic=4]This was composed during that chill session. You’ll see what I mean.
target: [pic=4]Ini kususun saat kita bersantai waktu itu. Nanti kamu paham maksudku.

source: [pic=4]They’re most recognized by their 5-7-5 syllable structure.
target: [pic=4]Ciri yang paling dikenal adalah pola suku katanya yang 5-7-5.

source: [pic=1]But structure is only one piece of the puzzle.
target: [pic=1]Tapi pola hanyalah satu bagian dari teka-tekinya.

source: [pic=2]A Haiku is a moment, an experience, if you will.
target: [pic=2]Haiku itu sebuah momen, sebuah pengalaman, begitulah.

source: [pic=3]Today’s chill will also involve some creativity.
target: [pic=3]Acara santai hari ini juga akan melibatkan kreativitas.

source: Remind me what that is, exactly?
That’s right! I’m here to chill.
[pic=1]Hey! Looks like you’ve made it to another chill session!
target: [pic=1]Hei! Rupanya kamu datang lagi untuk bersantai bersama!

source: Take me high above the clouds
[pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!
target: [pic=2]Tadi itu… cukup bagus, sungguh. Aku terkesan!

source: [pic=3]I see you were inspired by Penny, she’d be happy to hear this!
target: [pic=3]Rupanya Penny yang mengilhamimu. Dia pasti senang mendengarnya!

source: [pic=3]Absolutely, she’s a sap for this poetry stuff!
target: [pic=3]Betul sekali, dia mudah tersentuh oleh puisi seperti ini!

source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!
target: [pic=2]Tadi itu… cukup bagus, sungguh. Aku terkesan!

source: [pic=2]I dig the commentary! And good to see you’re an advocate of the chill life!
target: [pic=2]Aku suka komentarmu! Senang juga melihatmu mendukung hidup santai!

source: [pic=2]Yo, wait, are WE the bugs?? Damn.
[pic=3]Heh, that’s what she says to most of mine…
target: [pic=3]Heh, itu yang dia katakan untuk sebagian besar puisiku…

source: *This dialogue plays at the end of each ending.*
target: *This dialogue plays at the end of each ending.*

source:
Thanks guys!
Next chill session, I’ll have something better!
target:
Terima kasih, semuanya!
Lain kali kita bersantai bersama, aku akan membawa yang lebih bagus!

source: [pic=2]That was… actually pretty good. I’m impressed!
target: [pic=2]Tadi itu… cukup bagus, sungguh. Aku terkesan!

source: [pic=3]I see you were inspired by the bridge and your experiences in the forest. Very nice!
target: [pic=3]Rupanya jembatan dan pengalamanmu di hutan yang mengilhamimu. Bagus sekali!
